response.original_title: George Gurdjieff: His Life and Teaching
response.overview: Who was George Gurdjieff, and why does his teaching continue to attract people throughout the world? This full historical documentary explores the life, search and ideas of George Ivanovich Gurdjieff (1867–1949), the Greek-Armenian philosopher, spiritual teacher and composer associated with the Fourth Way.  Made by Jean-Claude Lubtchansky in 2005, a close associate of Madame de Salzmann, with the support of the Gurdjieff Institute in France, the film combines rare archival footage of Gurdjieff and the Gurdjieff Movements with music composed by Gurdjieff and Thomas de Hartmann. It sets out the basis of Gurdjieff’s teaching in his own words.
